picture-pairs.name: Zithunzi zofanana
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Masewera Olinganiza Zithunzi a Dementia: Zithunzi Zofanana
picture-pairs.h1: Zithunzi Zofanana: Masewera Odekha Olinganiza Zithunzi
picture-pairs.description: Masewera aulere komanso odekha olinganiza zithunzi a anthu okhala ndi vuto la dementia. Zithunzi zazikulu zimangokhala zooneka, palibe wotchi kapena masikoro, ndipo mumasankha zithunzi 4 mpaka 12.
picture-pairs.short: Pezani zithunzi ziwiri zofanana. Zithunzi zitha kungokhalabe zooneka.
picture-pairs.intro: Khudzani chithunzi chimodzi, kenako khudzani china chofanana nacho. Zithunzi zimakhala zooneka nthawi zonse, motero sipafunika kukumbukira chilichonse. Zithunzi ziwiri zikafanana, pakhala mzere wa golide m'mbali pamodzi ndi chizindikiro chovomereza.
howTo: Sankhani kuchuluka kwa zithunzi zimene mukufuna kugwiritsa ntchito. Zithunzi zinayi ndi malo abwino komanso odekha oyambira.
Khudzani chithunzi chilichonse. Chikhala ndi mzere wa golide m'mbali.
Khudzani chithunzi china chofanana nacho. Zithunzi zofananazo zizikhala pamodzi zokhala ndi chizindikiro chovomereza.
Ngati zithunzi ziwirizo zili zosiyana, palibe vuto lililonse. Khudzaninso nthawi ina iliyonse mukakhala okonzeka.
Yatsani "Zithunzi zobisika" pokhapokha ngati nonsenu mumakonda mtundu wodziwika bwino wozondotsa zithunzi pansi.
tips: Tchulani mayina a zithunzizo mofuula limodzi ndikukambirana za izo: "Kapu yofiira ya tiyi. Kodi mumathira mkaka mu tiyi mwanu?"
Lolani munthu amene mukumusamalira kuti azikhudza yekha, ngakhale zitenga kanthawi. Mungomuloza m'malo momukhudzira.
Pitirizani ndi zithunzi zinayi bola ngati zikukusangalatsani. Kuonjezera zithunzi ndi kusankha kwanu, sikuti ndi gawo limene mukuyenera kukwaniritsa.
Malizani pamene mukusangalalabe. Masewera amodzi okha ndi ntchito yokwanira bwino.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena masikoro?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, masikoro, kuwerengera mayendedwe kapena kulephera. Mutha kusiya nthawi ina iliyonse, ndipo kusiya pakati ndi njira yabwino kwambiri yomalizira.

faq.q: N'chifukwa chiyani zithunzi zimakhalabe zooneka?
faq.a: Kusiya zithunzi zikuoneka kumachititsa masewerawa kukhala oyang'ana ndi kulinganiza m'malo mokumbukira. Anthu ambiri amaona kuti izi zimakhala zodekha kwambiri. Mutha kusintha kuti zithunzi zizibisika pakungokhudza kamodzi ngati mukufuna.

faq.q: Kodi ndi zaulere, nanga ndikufunika kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi zaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Zimagwira ntchito mu msakatuli pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta.

faq.q: Kodi tingathe kugwiritsa ntchito zithunzi za banja lathu?
faq.a: Inde. Yesani Photo pairs, zomwe zimakulolani kusankha zithunzi kuchokera pa chipangizo chanu. Zithunzizo zimakhalabe mu msakatuli mwanu ndipo sizitumizidwa kwina kuli konse.

find-the-same.name: Pezani chofanana
find-the-same.seoTitle: Pezani Chithunzi Chofanana: Masewera Osavuta a Dementia
find-the-same.description: Chithunzi chimodzi pamwamba, ziwiri kapena zinayi pansi. Khudzani chimene chili chofanana nacho. Masewera odekha komanso aulere a zithunzi a anthu okhala ndi vuto la dementia, opanda wotchi.
find-the-same.short: Yang'anani chithunzi chapamwamba ndikukhudza chofanana nacho pansi.
find-the-same.intro: Chithunzi chimodzi chimakhala pamwamba pa sikirini. Pansi pake pamakhala zithunzi ziwiri, zitatu kapena zinayi. Khudzani chithunzi chimene chili chofanana. Ndi kusankha kumodzi kosavuta pa nthawi imodzi, kukhala ndi mwayi wokwanira wocheza.
howTo: Sankhani zithunzi ziwiri, zitatu kapena zinayi zoti musankhepo. Ziwiri ndiye zosavuta kwambiri.
Yang'anirani limodzi chithunzi chapamwamba.
Khudzani chithunzi chofanana nacho pansi. Chimayikidwa chizindikiro chovomereza pamodzi ndi mawu ochepa ofunda.
Ngati chakhudzidwa chithunzi chosiyana, masewerawa amangotchula dzina lake ndikudikirira. Tengani nthawi yanu.
Khudzani "Chithunzi chotsatira" mukakhala okonzeka kupita pa china.
tips: Kambiranani za chithunzi chilichonse musanasankhe: mitundu, maonekedwe, kapena komwe mungachione.
Zosankha ziwiri sizitanthauza kuti ndi "zosavuta mopitirira". Cholinga ndi kukhala ndi nthawi yosangalatsa, osati mayeso.
Ngati kukhudza kuli kovuta, munthuyo akhoza kuloza ndipo inu n'kumukhudzira.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena masikoro?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, masikoro, kuwerengera mayendedwe kapena kulephera. Mutha kusiya nthawi ina iliyonse, ndipo kusiya pakati ndi njira yabwino kwambiri yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi chimachitika n'chiyani ngati chakhudzidwa chithunzi cholakwika?
faq.a: Palibe chosasangalatsa chilichonse. Palibe phokoso lochenjeza, mtanda wofiira kapena kugwedezeka. Masewerawa amangotchula chithunzi chimene chakhudzidwacho ndikudikirira kukhudzidwanso kwina.

faq.q: Kodi ndi zaulere, nanga ndikufunika kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi zaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Zimagwira ntchito mu msakatuli pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta.

shadow-match.name: Kufananiza mthunzi
shadow-match.seoTitle: Masewera Olinganiza Mthunzi a Dementia: Zaulere pa Intaneti
shadow-match.h1: Kufananiza Mthunzi: Masewera Odekha a Zithunzi
shadow-match.description: Mthunzi wakuda pamwamba, zithunzi ziwiri kapena zinayi pansi. Khudzani chithunzi chimene chikupanga mthunziwo. Masewera aulere komanso odekha olinganiza mthunzi a anthu okhala ndi dementia, opanda wotchi.
shadow-match.short: Yang'anani mthunziwo ndikukhudza chithunzi chimene chikupanga mthunziwo.
shadow-match.intro: Kufananiza mthunzi ndi ntchito yodziwika bwino yopezeka pamapepala osindikiza, koma pano pali zithunzi zazikulu ndipo palibe chosindikiza. Mthunzi wooneka bwino umakhala pamwamba pa sikirini ndipo zithunzi ziwiri, zitatu kapena zinayi zimakhala pansi. Khudzani chithunzi chimene chikupanga mthunziwo. Zinthu monga njinga, ambulera kapena kapu ya tiyi n'zosavuta kukambirananso.
howTo: Sankhani zithunzi ziwiri, zitatu kapena zinayi zoti musankhepo. Ziwiri ndiye zosavuta kwambiri.
Yang'anirani limodzi mthunziwo. Ndi wooneka bwanji? Ndi woutali kapena wozungulira?
Khudzani chithunzi chimene chikupanga mthunziwo. Dzina lake lidzaonekera pansi pa mthunziwo.
Ngati chakhudzidwa chithunzi chosiyana, masewerawa amangotchula dzina lake ndikudikirira. Tengani nthawi yanu.
Khudzani "Mthunzi wotsatira" mukakhala okonzeka kupita pa wina.
tips: Tsatani m'mbali mwa mthunziwo ndi chala ndikukambirana mmene ulili.
Ngati mithunzi ikuoneka yovuta lero, sinthani n'kupita pa Pezani chofanana, komwe zithunzi zake zimakhala zofanana.
Kambiranani za chithunzicho chikapezeka: "Tinalinso ndi ambulera yotere."

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena masikoro?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, masikoro, kuwerengera mayendedwe kapena kulephera. Mutha kusiya nthawi ina iliyonse, ndipo kusiya pakati ndi njira yabwino kwambiri yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi kufananiza mithunzi n'kwabwino kwa anthu omwe ali ndi dementia?
faq.a: Ikhoza kukhala masewera osangalatsa komanso osavuta kwa anthu ena, makamaka m'magawo oyambirira. Maonekedwe ndi osavuta kuzindikira kuposa mawu. Ndi a chisangalalo ndi kukambirana, osati mayeso, ndipo sichichiritsa, kuchepetsa kapena kuteteza dementia. Ngati zikukhumudwitsa, yesani Pezani zofanana kapena ingoyang'anani zithunzi pamodzi.

faq.q: Nanga chimachitika chiyani ngati wina wasindikiza chithunzi cholakwika?
faq.a: Palibe chosasangalatsa. Palibe phokoso, chizindikiro chofiira kapena kugwedezeka. Masewerawa amatchula chithunzi chimene chasindikizidwa ndipo amadikira kusindikiza kotsatira.

faq.q: Kodi n'kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, n'kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa chilichonse. Imagwira ntchito mu msakatuli wa pa webusaiti pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta.

sort-together.name: Konzani pamodzi
sort-together.seoTitle: Masewera Okonza Zithunzi a Dementia: Konzani Pamodzi
sort-together.description: Sindikizani chithunzi, kenako sindikizani dengu limene n'kugwirizana nalo: khitchini kapena munda, zipatso kapena nyama. Masewera odekha komanso aulere okonza zithunzi kwa anthu omwe akukhala ndi dementia.
sort-together.short: Ikani chithunzi chilichonse m'dengu lake: khitchini kapena munda, ndi zina.
sort-together.intro: Kukonza zinthu ndi ntchito yodziwika ya tsiku ndi tsiku yomwe imakondweretsa, monga kuika zinthu za kukhitchini kapena kufananiza masokisi. Sindikizani chithunzi, kenako sindikizani dengu limene chiyenera kukhala. Palibe chifukwa chothamangira, ndipo palibe njira yolakwika.
howTo: Sankhani mutu: khitchini ndi munda, zipatso ndi nyama, kapena kwathu ndi ulendo.
Sindikizani chithunzi. Chidzalandira malire agolide.
Sindikizani dengu limene chithunzicho chiyenera kukhala. Chidzalowa m'dengulo.
Ngati chiyenera kukhala m'dengu linalo, masewerawo adzanena izi modekha ndipo adzadikira.
Zithunzi zonse zikakonzedwa, yang'anani madengu pamodzi.
tips: M'moyo weniweni, nthawi zambiri palibe yankho lolakwika. Ngati wina akuti chothirira madzi chiyenera kukhala kukhitchini, mufunseni chifukwa chake. Mwina mudzamva nkhani yabwino.
Gwiritsani ntchito zithunzi ngati chiyambi cha kukambirana: "Munkalima chiyani m'munda mwanu?"
Kukonza zinthu zenizeni, monga supuni ndi mafoloko kapena mabatani ndi mtundu wake, ndi njira yabwino yotsatira kunja kwa chinsalu.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena mphambu?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mphambu, kuwerengera mayendedwe kapena kugonja. Mutha kusiya nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kusiya pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: N'chifukwa chiyani kukonza?
faq.a: Anthu ambiri amakonda kukonza chifukwa kumamveka ngati ntchito yothandiza komanso yodziwika. Ndiponso n'kosavuta kukambirana za zithunzi pamene mukupitiriza.

faq.q: Kodi n'kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, n'kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa chilichonse. Imagwira ntchito mu msakatuli wa pa webusaiti pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta.

picture-puzzle.name: Puzzle ya zithunzi
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Puzzle Yosavuta ya Dementia: Zidutswa 4 kapena 9
picture-puzzle.description: Puzzle yosavuta ya pa intaneti kwa anthu omwe akukhala ndi dementia: zidutswa 4 kapena 9 zazikulu, chithunzi chonse chimakhalabe chowoneka, ndipo mumasindikiza zidutswa ziwiri kuti musinthane.
picture-puzzle.short: Sindikizani zidutswa ziwiri kuti musinthane mpaka chithunzi chikhale chokwanira.
picture-puzzle.intro: Chithunzi chokongola chimadulidwa kukhala zidutswa zinayi kapena zisanu ndi zinayi zazikulu ndi kusakanizidwa. Chithunzi chonse chimakhalabe chowoneka ngati chitsogozo. Sindikizani chidutswa chimodzi, kenako china, ndipo zidzasinthana malo. Sikofunikira kukokera.
howTo: Sankhani chithunzi ndi zidutswa 4 kapena 9. Zinayi ndi chiyambi chodekha.
Yang'anani chithunzi chonse pamwamba.
Sindikizani chidutswa, kenako sindikizani malo kumene chiyenera kukhala. Zidutswa ziwiri zidzasinthana.
Zidutswa zomwe zili pamalo oyenera zidzalandira chizindikiro chaching'ono cha tiki.
Chithunzi chikakhala chokwanira, sangalalani pamodzi, kenako sankhani china.
tips: Kusindikiza zidutswa ziwiri kuti musinthane n'kosavuta kwambiri kuposa kukokera, kwa anthu ambiri.
Kambiranani za chithunzi pamene chikukonzedwa: "Apa pali denga lofiira."
Puzzle yeniyeni ya matabwa ya zidutswa 12 mpaka 24 zazikulu ndi chinthu chokongola cha patebulo nayonso.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena mphambu?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mphambu, kuwerengera mayendedwe kapena kugonja. Mutha kusiya nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kusiya pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi ndiyenera kukokera zidutswa?
faq.a: Ayi. Sindikizani chidutswa chimodzi, kenako china, ndipo zidzasinthana malo. Izi n'zosavuta ngati dzanja likunjenjemera kapena pa chinsalu chaching'ono.

faq.q: Kodi n'kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, n'kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa chilichonse. Imagwira ntchito mu msakatuli wa pa webusaiti pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta.

finish-the-saying.name: Malizitsani mwambi
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Malizitsani Mwambi: Masewera a Miyambi kwa Okalamba
finish-the-saying.description: Miyambi yodziwika ndi mawu otsiriza osowa. Sankhani yankho kapena onetsani mathero, kenako kambiranani za iyo.
finish-the-saying.short: Malizitsani miyambi yodziwika pamodzi, kenako kambiranani za iyo.
finish-the-saying.intro: Miyambi yakale nthawi zambiri imadziwika kwa moyo wonse. Khadi lililonse limasonyeza mwambi wodziwika ndi mawu otsiriza osowa, zisankho zitatu, ndi batani la "Onetsani mathero". Mathero akawonekera, funso lodekha limakuitanani kukambirana.
howTo: Werengani mwambiwo mokweza pamodzi.
Sankhani mawu omalizitsa kapena sindikizani "Onetsani mathero".
Werengani mwambi wonse kachiwiri ndipo kambiranani pogwiritsa ntchito funsoli.
Sindikizani "Mwambi wotsatira" mukakonzeka.
tips: Werengani pang'onopang'ono ndipo siyani kaleka pang'ono musanatchule mawu omaliza. Nthawi zambiri anthu amanena mawuwo musanamalize.
Ngati wina apereka mathero osiyana, sangalalani nawo. Mitundu ina ya miyambi imasiyana malinga ndi banja kapena dera.
Mu gulu, munthu m'modzi amawerenga ndipo onse amalowa nawo pomaliza.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena mphambu?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mfundo, kauntala ya masitepe kapena kutaya. Mukhoza kuyimitsa nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuyimitsa pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Nanga ngati tisankha mawu ena?
faq.a: Masewerawa amaonetsa kutha kwake kwanthawi zonse ndipo amapitiriza ku kukambirana. Palibe mfundo, ndipo yankho lina ndi lolandirika.

faq.q: Kodi ndi kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito pa msakatuli wa pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta.

word-search.name: Masewera a mawu a zilembo zazikulu
word-search.seoTitle: Masewera a Mawu a Zilembo Zazikulu kwa Dementia, Osindikizidwa
word-search.h1: Masewera a Mawu a Zilembo Zazikulu
word-search.description: Masewera aulere a mawu a zilembo zazikulu kwa okalamba ndi anthu omwe ali ndi dementia. Mawu ochepa, zilembo zazikulu, mawu olembedwa molunjika kapena pansi pokha. Sewerani pa intaneti kapena sindikizani.
word-search.short: Zilembo zazikulu, mawu ochepa, molunjika kapena pansi pokha. Sindikizaninso.
word-search.intro: Gridi yaing'ono yokhala ndi zilembo zazikulu ndi mawu ochepa chabe, onse olembedwa molunjika kapena pansi. Dinani chilembo choyamba cha mawu, kenako chilembo chake chomaliza. Mukonda pepala? Sindikizani puzzle yatsopano ndi dinani limodzi.
howTo: Sankhani mutu ndi kukula kwa gridi.
Yang'anani mndandanda wa mawu. Mawu amawerengedwa molunjika (kumanzere kupita kumanja) kapena pansi (kuchokera pamwamba kupita pansi).
Dinani chilembo choyamba cha mawu, kenako dinani chilembo chake chomaliza.
Mawu opezeka amaonekera mwamtundu ndipo amachotsedwa pamndandanda.
Dinani "Sindikizani puzzle iyi" kuti musewere pa pepala ndi pensulo kapena cholembera.
tips: Lozerani mawu pamndandanda ndipo fufuzani chilembo chake choyamba pamodzi.
Pa pepala, cholembera chowunikira n'chosavuta kugwira kusiyana ndi pensulo.
Kambiranani mawu a mutu. Mawu a zipatso ndi njira yachilengedwe yobweretsera kukumbukira za kukolola, kuphika kapena msika.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena mfundo?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mfundo, kauntala ya masitepe kapena kutaya. Mukhoza kuyimitsa nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuyimitsa pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi ndingasindikize masewera a mawu?
faq.a: Inde. Dinani "Sindikizani puzzle iyi" kuti musindikize gridi yomwe ilipo mu zilembo zazikulu, ndi mndandanda wa mawu pansi pake. Puzzle iliyonse yatsopano ndi yosiyana.

faq.q: Kodi ndi kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito pa msakatuli wa pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta.

coloring.name: Mapepala ojambula
coloring.seoTitle: Mapepala Ojambula kwa Akuluakulu Omwe Ali ndi Dementia (Aulere)
coloring.description: Mapepala ojambula osavuta kwa akulu, okhala ndi malo akulu: dinani mtundu, kenako dinani chithunzi. Palibe chisokonezo, palibe mitundu yolakwika, ndipo tsamba lililonse likhoza kusindikizidwa kwaulere.
coloring.short: Dinani mtundu, kenako mbali ya chithunzi. Sindikizaninso mapepala.
coloring.intro: Mapepala okhala ndi mawonekedwe akulu komanso osavuta: duwa mu mphika, nyumba, kapu ya tiyi, gulugufe ndi bwato lapanyanja. Dinani mtundu, kenako dinani mbali ya chithunzi kuti mudzaze. Palibe mitundu yolakwika.
howTo: Sankhani tsamba.
Dinani mtundu. Mtundu uliwonse uli ndi dzina lake lolembedwa pamenepo.
Dinani mbali ya chithunzi kuti mudzaze ndi mtundu umenewo.
Sinthani maganizo nthawi iliyonse mwa kudzazanso.
Dinani "Sindikizani tsamba ili" kuti mupeze tsamba lopanda kanthu lojambulira ndi pensulo kapena cholembera.
tips: Perekani mitundu iwiri yosankha m'malo mwa seti yonse ngati kusankha kukuoneka kovuta.
Mitengo yofiirira ndi dzuwa labuluu ndi zolandirika. Cholinga ndi kusangalala ndi mitundu, osati kulondola.
Mapepala osindikizidwa amagwira bwino ntchito ndi zolembera zokhuthala kapena makrayoni, zomwe nzosavuta kugwira.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena mfundo?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mfundo, kauntala ya masitepe kapena kutaya. Mukhoza kuyimitsa nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuyimitsa pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi mapepalawa ndi a ana kwambiri?
faq.a: Tajambula zinthu zodekha komanso zosavuta m'malo mwa zithunzi zojambula, kotero mapepalawa ndi oyenera akulu. Mawonekedwe akulu amapangitsa kujambula kukhala kosavuta popanda kukhala ngati cha makanda.

faq.q: Kodi ndi kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito pa msakatuli wa pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta.

conversation-cards.name: Makadi okambirana
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Zoyambitsa Kukambirana kwa Dementia: Makadi a Zithunzi
conversation-cards.description: Makadi a zithunzi okhala ndi mafunso ofatsa oyambitsa kukambirana kwa anthu omwe ali ndi dementia: palibe mafunso oyesa, palibe mayankho olondola. Gwiritsani ntchito pa sikilini kapena sindikizani seti yonse.
conversation-cards.short: Makadi a zithunzi okhala ndi mafunso otseguka, ofatsa. Palibe mafunso oyesa.
conversation-cards.intro: Khadi lililonse limaphatikiza chithunzi chodziwika ndi kuitana kotseguka kukambirana, monga "Ndi nyengo yanji yomwe mumakonda kwambiri?" Palibe mayankho olondola ndipo palibe chofunika kukumbukira. Sankhani mutu kapena sakanizani zonse.
howTo: Sankhani mutu, kapena sungani "Makadi onse".
Werengani funso mokweza ndipo yang'anani chithunzicho pamodzi.
Mvetserani, gawani yankho lanu, ndipo lolani kukambirana kuyende momasuka.
Dinani "Khadi lotsatira" mukakonzeka, kapena khalani pakhadi limodzi nthawi yayitali momwe mukufunira.
Dinani "Sindikizani makadi onse" kuti mudule seti ya pepala.
tips: Yankhani funsoli nokha. Zimamveka ngati kukambirana, osati kufunsa mafunso.
Tsatirani nkhaniyo, osati zoona. Ngati tsatanetsatane wasintha, ndi bwino.
Ngati khadi likhudza chinthu chachisoni, vomerezani maganizo ndipo sunthani pang'onopang'ono ku khadi lina.

faq.q: Chifukwa chiyani palibe mafunso akuti "Mukukumbukira…?"
faq.a: Mafunso oyesa kukumbukira angaoneke ngati mayeso ndipo angayambitse manyazi. Kuitana kotseguka monga "Ndiuzeni za…" kumalola aliyense kulowa nawo, mosasamala kanthu zomwe akukumbukira.

faq.q: Kodi ndingasindikize makadi?
faq.a: Inde. "Sindikizani makadi onse" imasindikiza seti yonse mu zilembo zazikulu, makadi angapo pa tsamba, okonzeka kudulidwa.

faq.q: Kodi ndi kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi zaulere, ndipo sipafunika kukhala ndi akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa pulogalamu iliyonse. Zimagwira ntchito pa msakatuli wa pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta.

photo-pairs.name: Zithunzi zofananitsa
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Pangani Masewera Ofananitsa Pogwiritsa Ntchito Zithunzi za Banja
photo-pairs.description: Sinthani zithunzi za banja lanu kukhala masewera osavuta ofananitsa zithunzi. Sankhani zithunzi 2 mpaka 6 pa chipangizo chanu; sizichoka pa msakatuli wanu ndipo sizikwezedwa pena paliponse.
photo-pairs.short: Sankhani zithunzi zanu nʼkuzifananitsa. Palibe chomwe chimakwezedwa pa intaneti.
photo-pairs.players: Anthu 2, atakhala limodzi pambali ndi pambali
photo-pairs.intro: Sankhani zithunzi ziwiri mpaka zisanu ndi chimodzi kuchokera pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta yanu, ndipo zikhala masewera ofananitsa okhala ndi zithunzi zazikulu komanso zooneka bwino. Zithunzizi zimaonekera patsamba lino lokha. Sizikwezedwa pa intaneti, sizisungidwa kapena kugawidwa, ndipo zimazimiriratu mukatseka tsambali.
howTo: Dinani "Sankhani zithunzi" ndipo sankhani zithunzi ziwiri mpaka zisanu ndi chimodzi.
Chithunzi chilichonse chimatuluka kawiri. Dinani chimodzi, kenako dinani chinzake chofanana nacho.
Kambilanani za chithunzi chilichonse mukachipeza.
Mukamaliza, tsekani tsambali kapena dinani "Chotsani zithunzi". Palibe chomwe chimasungidwa.
tips: Sankhani zithunzi zooneka bwino za zinthu zosangalatsa komanso zodziwika bwino: chiweto, dimba, malo omwe mumawakonda, kapena tsiku la ukwati.
Zithunzi za malo ndi zinthu zitha kukhala zosavuta kuposa nkhope za anthu, ndipo zimathandiza kupewa kuumiriza munthu kutchula mayina a anthu.
Pewani zithunzi za anthu omwe anamwalira ngati zingadzutse chisoni mwadzidzidzi, pokhapokha mutadziwa kuti zimawabweretsera mtendere mumtima.

faq.q: Kodi zithunzi zanga zikukwezedwa pena paliponse?
faq.a: Ayi. Tsambali limangowerenga zithunzi zomwe mwasankha mwachindunji mu msakatuli wanu ndikuzionetsa pa chophimba chanu. Sizitumizidwa kwa ife kapena kwa wina aliyense, ndipo zimachoka mukatseka kapena kutsitsimutsa tsambali.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena kuwerengera mfundo za zotsatira?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, kulemba mfundo, kuwerengera mayendedwe kapena kuluza. Mutha kuyima nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kusiyira panjira ndi njira yabwino kwambiri yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi ndingasunge masewerawa kuti tidzasewerenso nthawi ina?
faq.a: Ayi, sitingachite zimenezo mu msakatuli pofuna kuteteza zinsinsi zanu, kotero palibe chilichonse chachinsinsi chomwe chimasungidwa. Pulogalamu yaulere ya Golden Moments ya iPhone ndi iPad imatha kusunga makope a zithunzi zomwe mwasankha pa chipangizo chanu.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo ya zithunzi
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Bingo ya Zithunzi ya Anthu Achikulire Amene Ali ndi Vuto Loiwalaiwala: Yosindikiza
picture-bingo.description: Bingo ya zithunzi yaulere yosindikiza ya magulu a anthu achikulire ndi omwe ali ndi vuto la kukumbukira, yokhala ndi chionetsero chachikulu pa chophimba. Zithunzi zazikulu zokhala ndi mawu, mabokosi 9 kapena 16, popanda kufunika koti munthu adziwe kuwerenga.
picture-bingo.short: Makhadi a bingo ya zithunzi osindikiza komanso chionetsero cha pa chophimba chachikulu cha magulu.
picture-bingo.intro: Masewera a bingo achizolowezi okhala ndi zithunzi m'malo mwa manambala, kuti pasakhale aliyense wofunika kuwerenga zilembo zazing'ono. Sindikizani makhadi osiyanasiyana, kenako gwiritsani ntchito chionetsero cha pa chophimba kuti muonetse chithunzi chilichonse chachikulu pa TV, laputopu kapena tabuleti.
howTo: Sankhani mabokosi 9 kapena 16 pa khadi lililonse komanso chiwerengero cha osewera.
Dinani "Sindikizani makhadi". Khadi lililonse ndi losiyana ndi linzake.
Tsegulani chionetserocho pa chophimba chachikulu. Dinani "Chithunzi chotsatira" kuti muonetse chithunzi chilichonse pamodzi ndi dzina lake.
Osewera amaphimba chithunzi chofanana pa khadi lawo pogwiritsa ntchito ndalama yachitsulo, batani kapena cholembera.
Aliyense amene wamaliza mzere, kapena khadi lonselo, amamuchomera mʼmanja mosangalala. Palibe woluza m'masewerawa: pitirizani kusewera mpaka aliyense atamaliza mzere.
tips: Gwiritsani ntchito zinthu zazikulu monga zotsekera mabotolo kapena zidutswa za drafti. Mabatani aang'ono amatha kukhala ovuta kuwanyamula m'manja.
Tchulani chithunzicho ndi kufotokozapo kanthu: "Bwato lamatanga. Ndani anakwerapo bwato mʼmbuyomu?"
Khalitsani anthu omwe ali ndi vuto loona pafupi kwambiri ndi chophimba, ndipo phatikizani othandizira ndi osewera omwe akufunika thandizo.
Mabokosi asanu ndi anayi ndi okwanira bwino kwa magulu ambiri. Chitani masewerawa kwa pafupifupi mphindi 20 mpaka 30.

faq.q: Kodi ndingatsogolere bwanji bingo ya zithunzi m'nyumba yosamalira anthu achikulire?
faq.a: Sindikizani khadi limodzi pa wosewera aliyense, ikani chionetserocho pa chophimba chachikulu kwambiri chimene muli nacho, ndipo tchulani zithunzizo modekha, kutchula chilichonse ndi dzina lake. Sewerani mpaka aliyense atamaliza mzere, kuti pasakhale wotsalira.

faq.q: Kodi ndi zaulere kusindikiza?
faq.a: Inde. Sindikizani makhadi ochuluka mmene mukufunira, pafupipafupi mmene mukufunira, kuti mugwiritse ntchito panokha kapena m'gulu.

faq.q: Kodi anthu angasewere popanda kudziwa kuwerenga?
faq.a: Inde. Bokosi lililonse lili ndi chithunzi chachikulu, chokhala ndi dzina lake pansi pake kwa iwo amene amakonda kuwerenga mawu.

calm-breathing.name: Kupuma modekha
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Kupumula Modekha kwa Anthu Achikulire ndi Owasamalira
calm-breathing.description: Nthawi yabata yopumira limodzi modekha: bwalo losavuta limakula ndikuchepa pa maulendo 6 a kupuma. Mumaliyambitsa nokha, ndipo mutha kuyimitsa nthawi iliyonse.
calm-breathing.short: Bwalo lomwe limayenda modekha kuti muzipumira limodzi nalo. Yambitsani ndi kuyimitsa nthawi iliyonse yomwe mukufuna.
calm-breathing.intro: Nthawi zina chinthu chabwino kwambiri chimangokhala kupumula mwabata. Dinani "Yambani", kenako pumirani mkati pamene bwalo likukula ndi kutulutsa mpweya pamene likuchepa. Sankhani kayendedwe kocheperapo kapena kofulumirapo. Si chithandizo chamankhwala, koma ndi mphindi yabata yongogawana limodzi.
howTo: Khalani bwino pambali ndi pambali.
Sankhani kayendedwe: wodekha kapena wofatsa.
Dinani "Yambani". Pumirani mkati pamene bwalo likukula, ndipo tulutsani mpweya pamene likuchepa.
Limayima lokha pakapita maulendo 6 opuma, kapena dinani "Imitsani" nthawi iliyonse yomwe mukufuna.
tips: Gwirani m'manja kapena ikani dzanja pa mkono wa munthu amene mukumusamalirayo ngati akusangalala nazo.
Musaumirize nʼkomwe. Ngati akufuna kungopenyerera, zilibe vuto lililonse.
Ngati wina ali ndi vuto la kupuma, apume mwachizolowezi ndikungopenyerera bwalolo. Funsani dokotala pa vuto lililonse lokhudza kupuma.

faq.q: Kodi uku ndi masewera olimbitsa thupi a kupuma a kuchipatala?
faq.a: Ayi. Ndi mpumulo wosavuta komanso wosakakamiza wofuna kubweretsa bata ndi kukhala limodzi. Si chithandizo cha nkhawa kapena vuto lililonse la thanzi. Lankhulani ndi dokotala ngati muli ndi nkhawa iliyonse yokhudza thanzi.

faq.q: Kodi bwaloli limayenda popanda ine kulyambitsa?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe chimene chimayenda mpaka mutakhudza Yambani, ndipo chimasiya pambuyo pa mpweya sikisi kapena mukakhudza Imani. Ngati chipangizo chanu chakhazikitsidwa kuti chepetse kuyenda, mawu amasintha popanda bwalo kukula.

faq.q: Kodi ndi kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito mu msakatuli (browser) pa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.
